sections.label: Host Welcome & Halloween Teaser
sections.text:
Pull up a chair and sit a spell.  I'm Charlie and this here's Lone Star Doxie Talk.

Well now friends, I reckon October has rolled right on in, and I have to confess, it is easily one of my absolute favorite months of the entire year. Around these parts, the air finally starts to feel a little less hot, the leaves start turnin', and of course, Halloween is just around the corner.

Now, picking out my costume every year is a bit of a process. Just like a bride looking for her wedding dress, you try on a lot of NOs before you finally find your YES.

We took our cameras with us down to the costume shop so you could have a glimpse at this year's candidates. Let's take a look!
sections.speaker_directions: Warm and friendly direct address, smiling delivery, playful comedic build-up to the montage.

sections.label: CTDR News & Community Announcements
sections.text:
Well, what do you think?  Fangs, cape, and all, I am ready for the spooky season.   Alright, it's time to get down to the business of the heart.

First off today, I want to send out a great big Texas-sized thank you to every single one of our CTDR family members who chipped in to contribute to the CTDR Summertime Fundraiser.

Your donations help to fund boarding at Day Lily, our wonderful veterinary partner, as well as covering spay and neuter for incoming rescues, essential vet care, and life-saving heartworm treatment. Y'all truly keep this rescue wagon rollin', and we are mighty grateful.

Next up, don't forget to head over to ctdr.org and order your CTDR 2027 Wall Calendar. It is packed full of the sweetest doxie faces you ever did see, and every single calendar purchased directly supports our rescue dogs.  They make wonderful Christmas gifts, too!

I know we've been talking about this event for awhile now, but Wienerfest is almost here! Our friends at Zilkerbark are hosting the 4th Annual Wiener Dog meetup out at the Sherwood Forest Faire in McDade, Texas, just outside of Austin. It's happening on Saturday, October 31st, from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. CTDR is planning to be there, wagging our tails and spreading the word about our incredible doxies. You can grab your tickets online at the link down in the description.

Now friends, October is also Breast Cancer Awareness Month, and the focus for 2026 is: Every story is unique, every journey matters.

Did you know that breast cancer is still the most common non-skin cancer in American women?

Even so, with early detection, the five-year survival rate is currently just north of ninety percent. Early detection is critical.

So if you haven't already, please have a heart-to-heart with your doctor about creating an appropriate screening and self-examination schedule based on your unique medical profile. We love our CTDR family, and we want everyone healthy and strong.

Now for my favorite segment of every episode... It's time for the September Happy Tails Adoptions!!
sections.speaker_directions: Charlie in Dracula costume. Energetic transition, sincere gratitude for donors, enthusiastic about Wienerfest, shifting into compassionate tone for Breast Cancer Awareness, ending with high excitement introducing Happy Tails.

sections.label: September Happy Tails Adoption Stories
sections.text:
First up, let's give a warm Texas hello to handsome Otis!

This sweet boy was lovingly looked after by his wonderful foster, Christine, who gave him all the care and TLC in the world to get him ready for his next big adventure.

Well, Tom and Lana down in Lake Jackson saw that darling face and knew Otis was the missing piece to their puzzle!

They stepped right up to give him his forever home. Happy trails to you, Otis, may your days be filled with sunshine, warm breezes, and plenty of backyard exploring!

Next up... get a load of this gorgeous girl with a mighty name — Chimera!

Now, talk about a happily ever after! Chimera was being fostered over in Round Rock by Dave and Beth.

Well, wouldn't you know it — Dave and Beth fell head over heels for this sweet lady and decided she was already right where she belonged! Another joyous foster failure to warm our hearts!

And get this, friends — Dave and Beth are seasoned CTDR repeat adopters who just recently welcomed Chimera's brother, Cerberus, into their pack!

How about that for a family reunion? Having both Cerberus and Chimera together in such a loving home just tickles me pink.

Two precious lives, two beautiful beginnings.

To Christine, Dave and Beth, Tom and Lana, and everyone who opens their home to foster and adopt — thank you from the bottom of our hearts for giving these rescue pups the second chances they so richly deserve.
sections.speaker_directions: Warm, celebratory narration of September adopted doxies, transitioning into heartfelt gratitude for CTDR fosters, adopters, and supporters.

sections.label: Episode Conclusion & CTA
sections.text:
Well friends, we've covered a whole lot of ground today! From costume try-outs and Wienerfest excitement, to honoring Breast Cancer Awareness and thanking everyone who supported our summertime fundraiser, it has been another great episode.

If you'd like to lend a helping paw, whether by fostering, adopting, donating, or volunteering, please visit ctdr.org.

Until next time, remember, a rescued heart never forgets.
sections.speaker_directions: Warm, encouraging recap, sincere volunteer/donation appeal, and solemn trademark sign-off.
